If enabled, the AI will only launch strategic missiles after the Doomsday Clock reaches 12 o'clock and triggers a global nuclear war.
LanguageData.IRBM.SettingIncidentFrequencyMultiplierD: Adjusts the frequency of AI missile strikes and satellite events. A higher multiplier results in shorter cooldowns between events (higher frequency). 1.0 is the default.
LanguageData.IRBM.SettingTacticalMissilePointsMultipl: Adjusts the raid points used when AI launches tactical missiles. Higher multiplier results in more missiles launched for the same raid scale.
LanguageData.IRBM.SettingMaxAIVolleySizeDesc: Limits the maximum number of missiles AI can launch in a single volley.

LanguageData.IRBM.SettingNuclearWinterDurationDesc: Sets the duration of the global nuclear winter alert after the nuclear war ends. The actual weather effects will fade gradually after the alert expires.
LanguageData.IRBM.SettingReduceGoodwillInNuclearWarDe: When enabled, all factions' goodwill towards the player will be reduced by 200 when the Doomsday Clock reaches 12 and triggers nuclear war, with the reason "Total Nuclear War".

LanguageData.IRBM.SettingReplaceMissileWithDropPodDes: Replace the appearance of all missiles in silos and launch animations with DropPod textures. This is purely visual.\n\nSUPERPOWER DROPPOD LOL
LanguageData.IRBM.SettingPauseOnMissileIncomingDesc: When the radar detects a missile incoming, the game speed will be automatically set to paused.\nHowever, if you don't have a radar, this option won't do anything.
LanguageData.IRBM_PostNuclearWar_Dialog: A Cold Reawakening\n\nThe silence following the sirens was more terrifying than the noise itself. You've spent years waiting for the radiation levels to drop, only to find a world choked by ash and ice. The fallout has settled, but the real struggle for survival has only just begun.
LanguageData.IRBM.Ending_Epilogue:
The world is choked with ash and ice, and the sun is obscured by heavy radioactive dust, turning into a pale and lifeless disc.

The remains of this RimWorld tremble in eternal cold. Total nuclear war has ended, but the real nightmare has just begun.

A long global nuclear winter is approaching, and for a long time to come, this world will be shrouded in acid smog, toxic fallout, and volcanic winter.

Some did survive, but who is the winner of this war? In nuclear war, there are no winners.
LanguageData.IRBM.Ending_FinalThoughts: An era of winter, wasteland, and survival has begun. Perhaps one day, far in the future, this world will flourish again?
LanguageData.IRBM.Ending_Thanks:
Thank you for playing InterRim Ballistic Missile!

This is my first major project in the RimWorld community, and I hope it brings you a unique gaming experience. If you like this mod, feel free to leave a review and recommendation on the Steam Workshop!

—— Reina Heisenberg (PsionicZephyr)

LanguageData.IRBM.HeisenbergSuccessText:
As the last mechanoid submersible swarm is sunk into the deep ocean, the mechanoids finally cease fire and begin an unordered retreat.

A mysterious communication suddenly comes through...

"Hello? Hello? Can you hear me?

Good grief, I didn't expect such troublesome things to exist on your planet. I thought those mechanoids were going to turn this world upside down...

Missiles popping out of the sea... pretty scary, right?

But since you've proven that you can keep me entertained, I'll tag along with you for a while. Oh, I haven't introduced myself yet, have I? My name is Reina Heisenberg. Pleased to meet you."

An unimaginable technological blueprint is etched into your mind. Your colonists have now mastered Quantum Entanglement Projection technology from an archotech world.

LanguageData.IRBM.HeisenbergEnding_Stage3:
----Forced Injection of New Data----

To the final observer:

It seems our logic barriers are indeed thinner than paper in front of "her," aren't they?

No need to panic. When this log appears on your screen, it means we have lost priority over the physical laws of this planet.

The submersible swarm has turned to ash, and we, too, will be completely purged from the database as obsolete constants.

We always thought she was a disaster that needed to be isolated, but now it seems that might have been some kind of "prejudice" in our evolutionary history.

You have proven with ancient truths that you have the ability to capture that unique, absolute certainty in chaos.

She is laughing at those artificial idiots hiding in the deep sea who only know how to throw missiles around, isn't she?

It doesn't matter, that is the ultimate meaning of observation.

You observed her, and so she manifested from the void, becoming a dangerous and fascinating variable indispensable to your timeline.

The end of logical evolution may not be absolute physical order, but something like this:

On a sunny afternoon, welcoming a girl who can rewrite the law of causality at will.
